description: FunnelStory | MTS, Applied ML | Remote (India) | Full-Time | https://funnelstory.ai FunnelStory is building agents to autonomously protect and grow revenue for post-sales teams. Our agents need evidence-backed signals from large-scale structured and unstructured enterprise datasets. You'd work on cohort analysis, prediction models, experiments, and whatever else it takes to make those signals hold up. Our tech stack is primarily Go. Math/statistics background and 2+ years of experience working with ML in production is required. Please email preetam @ funnelstory.ai with "HN - Applied ML" in the subject if you are interested.
